modes.description: Everyone forges slop; one entry is the live model. Find it. The spine of the night.
Warm-up. Funniest stereotypical AI response wins; no ground truth, pure performance. Burns off the loud parody so Classic forgeries get subtle.
Inverted Classic: everyone writes authentically; the bot tries to pass as human. Daytime version of the finale; yields the authentic-human corpus class.
Secret persona cards (Corporate GPT, Therapist GPT...); same prompt; table attributes responses to personas. Best read-aloud mode.
Earned only. Bot enters with listening context, intimate prompt deck, big pot. Two endings per night: humanity holds, or it got in.
Secret objective; steer the live model toward it in 3 exchanges while the table bets and guesses the objective. Needs exchange.message engine support.
Forge plausible-looking code; table bets on which snippets pass hidden tests; harness runs them live, lights one at a time.
Nobody types code: 60s to write a prompt; generations race the tests during the read-aloud/betting overlap. The accessible code mode — casual tier by design.
Bot presents a solution with one injected flaw; first to name the line. Run it and watch it fail weirdly for the vibes-based players.
